# Kindred Coach

> Kindred Coach is a personal wellness companion that helps people build daily structure and self-awareness through guided journaling, habit tracking, medication logging, and conversation with Kindred — a warm, grounded AI coach powered by Claude.

## Core public pages

- [Home](https://kindred-asterling.replit.app/): Product overview and value proposition
- [About](https://kindred-asterling.replit.app/about): The story and mission behind Kindred Coach
- [The Science](https://kindred-asterling.replit.app/science): Research and principles behind the coaching approach
- [Pricing](https://kindred-asterling.replit.app/pricing): Subscription plans and in-app checkout

## Product summary

Kindred Coach guides users through morning mental-load check-ins, midday body scans (emotions, energy, physical sensations), and evening reflections. It tracks daily habits with streak counting, manages multi-dose medication schedules with dose logging and effectiveness ratings, and provides a 7-day combined report. The in-app AI coach, Kindred, reads the user's profile and recent journal data to give specific, grounded responses — not generic advice.

Access requires a subscription (yearly or lifetime) purchased with Square in-app checkout.
